Where your co-workers are invested in you and your success. Where you are encouraged and supported to do your very best and given the tools and resources to do so. Where it’s a priority that the company takes good care of you and your family.

Our employees are the heart of our company. As an employer of choice, our goal is to provide a challenging, progressive and inclusive work environment which fosters personal leadership, career growth and development for every employee. We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world.

Job Description

Job Duties:

Plan and conduct geologic and environmental investigations
Conduct drilling and logging for moderate to highly complex projects
Log soil/rock cores and prepare boring logs per ASTM/USCS standards
Collect and manage environmental and geotechnical samples for laboratory analysis
Install and maintain groundwater monitoring wells/instrumentation
Prepare technical field notes, logs, and support documentation.
Attend progress meetings.
Perform other duties as assigned.
This is a pipeline requisition for future project hires.

Skills & Abilities

Must be a U.S. citizen.
Able to pass a federal background check.
Able to pass a medical examination.
Ability to work in the field which can include long periods of standing, walking or sitting.
Proficient in soil/rock logging, boring logs, and well installations.
Knowledge of OSHA/HAZWOPER and environmental standards.
Strong technical writing, problem-solving, and GIS/software skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks.
Federal project experience is highly desirable.
Strong organizational skills to balance and prioritize work.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance.
Strong writing and oral communication skills to work with military clients, contractors, and government teams.
Good interpersonal skills to cultivate relationships with colleagues, customers, and partners.
Ability to work independently in field settings under limited supervision.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree.
5 years of relevant experience.

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a college degree.

Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.

PG (Professional Geologist) License.
Knowledge of Unified Soil Classification System for logging soils.
40-hour OSHA Hazwoper certification with 8-hour annual refresher training which is up to date.

30-hour OSHA Construction Industry safety class.
Current CPR/FA/AED certification.

100%

jobs.description:
About GLOVIS America Inc.

GLOVIS America, Inc. is a third-party logistics provider headquartered in Irvine, CA. Since our inception in 2002, we are committed to delivering our customers products via truck, rail, or ocean vessel throughout the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Glovis America makes every effort to exceed standards by providing quality service to our customers and vendors of the automotive, freight forwarding, parts distribution, used car, and fuel industries. We cater logistics strategies and processes to our customers' needs by utilizing the latest information systems and advanced technologies.

Summary

The PIO Data Analyst, Performance Support Team position is responsible for supporting daily PIO parts operations through data management, system mapping, ASN administration, and OEM Parts Consignment support. The role ensures data accuracy, transaction visibility, and reporting consistency by maintaining PIO activity code mapping, validating parts and shipment data, supporting consignment inventory activities, and coordinating with Port Operations and related stakeholders to resolve operational data issues. Success in this role requires strong capabilities in data validation, system administration, operational reporting, inventory tracking, and cross-functional coordination.

Responsibilities

Support daily PIO parts operations through system, data, and reporting activities.
Manage and maintain PIO activity code mapping to ensure accurate operational and system data alignment.
Administer ASN activities, including shipment data review, validation, status tracking, and issue follow-up.
Support OEM Parts Consignment operations through inventory tracking, transaction review, reconciliation support, and reporting.
Maintain and validate PIO parts master data and related system information.
Review parts movement, receipt, consumption, adjustment, and inventory data to identify discrepancies or data issues.
Support investigation and resolution of parts shortages, inventory discrepancies, and transaction exceptions.
Prepare and maintain recurring PIO parts operational reports, KPIs, and data validation reports.
Support inventory audits, physical counts, and reconciliation activities through data preparation and validation.
Coordinate with Port Operations, warehouses, OEM representatives, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve PIO parts data and system-related issues.
Identify recurring data or process issues and support corrective actions and operational improvements.
Maintain supporting records and documentation related to PIO mapping, ASN, consignment inventory, and operational reporting.
Support PIO parts capacity planning by providing volume, inventory, and operational data.
Assist with ad hoc data analysis and reporting related to PIO parts operations.
Support system testing, mapping changes, and implementation of new PIO-related processes.
Assist with SOP, work instruction, and process documentation updates.
Support special projects related to PIO parts operations, inventory control, and data standardization.

Compensation Range

$55,000 - $70,000 per year (Subject to Compensation Study Upon Candidate Selection)

Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance
Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
Basic Life and AD&D as well as Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

Wellness Program and Gym Reimbursement*
401(k) with Generous Matching
Referral Bonuses*
Auto Allowance*
Quarterly Employee Lunches, Summer Refreshments, and Monthly Team Building Activities*
Discretionary Bonuses*
Tuition Reimbursement*
Benefits may vary by location. All benefits pursuant to Company policy

Skills & Qualifications

Audit reporting and documentation management
Project coordination and organizational skills
Proficient written and verbal communication skills for clear and professional reporting Required
Advanced proficiency in Power BI dashboard development, data visualization, and business intelligence reporting Preferred
Warehouse Inventory, supply chain, or distribution industry experience
Proficient ability to work cross-functionally with operations, finance, vendors, and third-party partners Required
Advanced attention to detail with a strong control-oriented mindset Required
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, validate, and interpret large datasets to identify trends, exceptions, and performance insights Required
Understanding of data quality, data governance, validation techniques, and reporting accuracy controls.
Ability to translate business requirements into meaningful reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.
Ability to coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders and provide analytical support for operational, financial, and system-related issue identification, investigation, and resolution.

Education & Experience

Bachelors Degree Required
2-3 years of direct experience in Information Systems, Accounting, Billings, Financial Analysis, Data Analysis, Economics Preferred

Treating others with dignity and respect, without discrimination.
